description: The quotient of \(A\) by equality of outputs of \(f:A\to B\) is in bijection with \(f(A)\), via \([a]\mapsto f(a)\) with its range membership recorded.
signature:
Setoid.quotientKerEquivRange.{u_1, u_2} {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} (f : α → β) :
  Quotient (Setoid.ker f) ≃ ↑(Set.range f)
